integrity: Original claim limited to a binary parity classification; the general bound and exact coefficient formulas from cited literature are acknowledged as prior results. Formal-power-series proof and independent integer checks are supplied.
scientific_limitations: Determines exactly when the established 2-adic lower bound is attained, but not higher valuations when it is strict. Bibliographic equivalences, notably implicit modular consequences of existing arbitrary-signature formulas, remain possible.
title: Binary submask criterion for the sharp two-adic exponent of recursive divisor counts
